messages:
maria: heads up — JIT onboarding failing for tenant acme-co. SCIM returns 400 when externalId/email contains characters like '&' or '<'. seeing KMS decrypt errors around the same time. anyone else?

tyler: can you paste the raw SAML assertion (sanitized) and the scim request/response? also which idp (Okta, AAD)?

maria: Okta. raw SAML snippet (sanitized):
```xml
<saml:Attribute Name="email">
  <saml:AttributeValue>a&b@example.com</saml:AttributeValue>
</saml:Attribute>
```
this goes through our idp-proxy -> provisioner. SCIM payload we send to provisioning service ends up with unescaped `&` and the SCIM API returns 400: "Invalid JSON payload". KMS logs at same time: `kms: decrypt failed: context mismatch` and `bad header` in rewrap step. :grimacing:

leo: hmm. two things could be happening in parallel: 1) idp-proxy is not XML-escaping AttributeValue before we consume it, and 2) the provisioning service expects extId to be rewrapped with a specific KMS context that changed during a recent key rotation. did we rotate any keys yesterday? @security-bot ?

security-bot: alert: KMS key rewrap job completed 1717429000 — rotated alias "alias/provisioner-extid". Related audit: https://audit.redwood.internal/kms/1717429000 :rotating_key:

ops-oncall: I hit this in staging earlier — when KMS context doesn't match we log `decrypt: invalid context` and fall back then try another key version which sometimes produces a corrupt payload that fails JSON parse. quick repro:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://provisioner.staging.redwood/api/v1/users -d @payload.json -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -v
# returns 400 with body: {"detail":"invalid_request","message":"malformed attribute value"}
```

infra: logs from provisioner (excerpt):
```
2026-04-01T12:02:13Z provisioner DEBUG receiving SAML attrs for tenant acme-co
2026-04-01T12:02:13Z provisioner DEBUG attr email raw: a&b@example.com
2026-04-01T12:02:13Z kms ERROR decrypt: context mismatch for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/aaaa-1111
2026-04-01T12:02:13Z provisioner ERROR failed to unmarshal user payload: invalid character '\u0026' in string literal
```

tyler: that `invalid character '\u0026'` means we attempted to interpret unescaped `&` inside a JSON string. We should ensure XML->JSON conversion escapes XML entities before marshaling. Also KMS context mismatch needs investigation — maybe key alias swap changed encryption context format (we added tenant id earlier).

leo: proposed short-term mitigation: update provisioner to normalize incoming AttributeValue with a sanitizer: replace `&` -> `&`, `<` -> `<`, `>` -> `>` before any JSON encoding. Long-term: ensure idp-proxy emits properly escaped values or adjust Okta claim transform to URL-encode extId.

maria: confirmed adding a quick sanitizer in staging provisioner fixed onboarding for sample users. no more 400s. but KMS decrypts still logged occasionally.

infra: KMS note — during rotation we switched from context format v1 -> v2 (added `tenant_id` field). Older extids encrypted with v1 fail unless rewrapped. ops-oncall can run a rewrap job to re-encrypt extids with v2 context.

ops-oncall: I'll queue a rewrap job for acme-co (small tenant) and run in canary. plan: 1) export extid blobs (read-only), 2) decrypt with old key/context, 3) encrypt with new key/context, 4) atomically swap in DB. will notify when canary done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: action items from here:
- short: patch provisioner to sanitize xml entities (PR opened: https://stash.redwood.internal/p/prov/+/1234) — verified in staging
- medium: run KMS rewrap canary for acme-co (ops-oncall)
- long: add end-to-end unit tests for SAML->idp-proxy->provisioner pipeline ensuring xml escaping preserved and KMS context compatibility

leo: extra: add a trace log in idp-proxy to dump escaped vs raw AttributeValue in debug mode (redact secrets) so we can see where transform happens. also add a migration ticket for customers with legacy extids.

security-bot: creating incident ticket SEC-2026-045 for triage & postmortem, assigning to @maria @ops-oncall @leo. link: https://issues.redwood.internal/SEC-2026-045

maria: thanks — I'll coordinate with ops-oncall. tagging @product-security for timeline. :thumbsup:
